spike-deny.description: SPIKE: denies everything. Used to prove agent-scoped permission isolation.

spike-ask.description: SPIKE: asks before bash. Used to raise a permission request over SSE.

spike-voice.description: SPIKE: no tools at all. Voice-like.

spike-bashonly.description: SPIKE: every tool denied except bash, which asks. Used to A/B the per-message `tools` key.
